sentences.en: A gang of three robbed the bank in broad daylight.
sentences.zh: 三个家伙在大白天抢劫了银行。

sentences.en: Somebody tipped off the gang members to the police surveillance.
sentences.zh: 有人向帮派成员报了警。

sentences.en: He was involved in a skirmish with a violent gang.
sentences.zh: 他与一伙暴力分子发生了冲突。
